notes: First three points are reported actuals (Q1-Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue) each quoted directly from Broadcom's own quarterly earnings press releases as syndicated on PR Newswire, all same publisher (prnewswire.com) per rule 5. Did not use investors.broadcom.com directly (repeated fetch timeouts); used the PR Newswire syndication of the same releases instead, which is not on the excluded-sites list.
